%name% is not an image: Error message shown when a picked file is not an image during upload. %name% is the file name, for example holiday-photo.pdf.
%progress% %nouns%… %done%/%total%: Progress toast of a bulk action running on many selected rows. %progress% is a verb like Deleting, %nouns% the plural item name like tracks, %done%/%total% e.g. 2/5.

Account not found or current Auth Accoun: Error message from the server when a user account cannot be loaded: it does not exist or the signed-in user may not see it.
Add %entity%: Label of the primary button at the top right of a list page that creates a new item. %entity% is the singular item name, e.g. World or Push Notification. Imperative.
All__filter-option: On the admin UI Showcase page (Maintenance), label of the quick-filter pill that clears the status filter and shows every item. Single word.
Auto-translate: Button next to a translatable text field that fills the other languages automatically from the current text by AI. Imperative.
breadcrumb__navigation: Accessible name (screen reader label) of the breadcrumb navigation trail at the top of admin pages; use a short lowercase noun like the English.
Bulk actions: Accessible name (screen-reader label) of the toolbar that appears above a list when rows are selected, holding actions that apply to all selected rows.
Cancel: Button at the bottom of the world form that discards the entries and returns to the world list; asks for confirmation if there are unsaved changes.
Cancel__confirm-dialog: Button on the left of a generic confirmation dialog that dismisses it without doing the action. Shown when the caller did not set its own label.
Cancel__form-dialog: Button on the left of a dialog that holds a short form (rename, create, delete with a reason); closes the dialog without saving. Asks first when the form has unsaved changes. Shown when the caller did not set its own label.
Type “%phrase%” to confirm: Label above the text field of a confirmation dialog for an irreversible step; the confirm button stays off until the user types the phrase exactly. %phrase% is the phrase to type (for example the name of the item to delete). Keep the quotation marks around it.
Cancel__media-picker: Footer button of the media picker dialog; click to close the dialog without changing the chosen media item.
Change__media-field-action: Button label under a media field preview; click to open the picker and replace the currently chosen image. Shown only when an image is already set.
Clear %label%: Accessible label of the small X button inside a text filter that empties it. %label% is the filter name, e.g. Name or Account ID.
Clear all: Button at the bottom of a multi-select dropdown that deselects every option in the list.
Clear all translations: Tooltip and accessible label of the small trash-can icon button in the label row of a translatable text field in an admin form; it deletes the text of every language of that field after a confirmation.
Clear all translations?: Title of a confirmation dialog in translatable text fields of admin forms; asks whether to delete the texts of every language of the field.
Clear all__translations-action: Button that deletes the text of every language of one translatable field, and the confirm button of the dialog that follows. Imperative.
Clear filters: Button in a list toolbar that resets all active filters at once. It only appears while at least one filter is set.
Clear search: Outlined button in the empty state of a list when a search or filter found nothing; it resets the search so all rows show again. Imperative.
Clear__selection-action: Link-style button in the bulk-action bar that deselects all currently selected list rows. Imperative, short.
Close__dialog-close-button: Close button of a popup dialog, either an icon with screen-reader text in the top corner or a footer button. Imperative: dismisses the dialog.
Close__drawer-close-button: Accessible label (screen reader and tooltip) of the small X icon button in the corner of a right-side form drawer. Closes the drawer and may ask to discard unsaved changes.
Close__sheet-close-button: Screen-reader label of the X icon in the corner of a side panel (sheet) that slides in from the screen edge. Imperative: closes the panel.
Collapse %title%: Accessible label (screen reader and tooltip) of the round chevron button that collapses a group panel on a dashboard. %title% is the group name, for example 'Running'.
Command Palette: Hidden (screen-reader only) title of the command palette dialog, a search popup for jumping to pages and actions in the admin app.
Confirm__confirm-dialog: Button on the right of a generic confirmation dialog that carries out the action asked about. Shown when the caller did not set its own label.
Copy ID: Tooltip of the small copy icon button next to an ID in a list table; copies the ID to the clipboard. Imperative.
Copy ID %id%: Accessible label (screen reader and tooltip) of the small button that copies the record ID to the clipboard, shown in the metadata block of every detail screen. %id% is the record ID, for example 4711 or a UUID. Imperative tone.
Created__entity-metadata: Label in the metadata block of a detail screen, placed before the date and time the record was created, for example 'Created 12 Nov 2026, 10:15'. Keep it short.
Discard changes?: Title of the confirmation dialog shown when the user closes a form drawer that has unsaved edits. Phrased as a question.
Discard__unsaved-changes-confirm: Destructive confirm button of the discard dialog; clicking it closes the form and loses the unsaved edits. Imperative verb.
Dismiss: Button in the AI translation panel that hides the finished progress list of the last translation run. Imperative.
Edit__action: Default accessible name and tooltip of the small pencil icon button in the top-right corner of a settings card; clicking it opens the edit form for that card. Imperative verb.
Enter %language% text…: Placeholder of a text input in a translatable field; %language% is the name of the active language tab, e.g. 'German'.
Export to Excel: Sample text of the outline button specimen in the UI showcase; imperative, exports a list as a spreadsheet. Maintenance UI showcase screen, Buttons section.
Filters: Button text in a list toolbar that opens or closes the collapsible panel with extra filters. Hidden on phones, where only the icon shows.
Form sections: Accessible label (aria-label) of the small sticky navigation bar at the top of a long admin form (challenge, campaign) that jumps between its panels.
Grid view: Tooltip and accessible label of the icon button in a list toolbar that switches the list to a grid of cards.
ID__entity-id: Label in the metadata block of a detail screen, placed before the record's unique identifier, for example 'ID 4711'. Keep it short, uppercase-friendly.
Informal__writing-style: Writing style option: texts address the user informally (German 'du', French 'tu'). Shown in the language menu and account forms. One word, an adjective.
Keep editing: Cancel button of the discard dialog; clicking it returns the user to the open form so no edits are lost. Imperative.
Languages: Navigation menu entry in the admin sidebar that opens the Languages area. Keep it short, as it is a single menu label.
Loading: Accessible label of a spinning loader shown while a chart on the activity statistics screens is loading. Screen readers announce it.
Loading more: Accessible name (screen-reader label) of the spinner at the end of a list while the next page of rows is being loaded during infinite scroll.
More actions: Accessible label (tooltip for screen readers) of an icon-only button showing three dots that opens more actions. Sample in the UI showcase, Buttons section.
More__breadcrumb-ellipsis: Screen reader only text next to the '...' icon in a shortened breadcrumb trail; announces that further, hidden path levels exist.
No: Option of a yes/no filter in the filter panel of a list; selecting it shows only records where the flag is not set.
No changes: Status text next to the Save and Cancel buttons of an edit form, shown while nothing has been changed since the form was loaded or saved.
No image: Empty-state text inside a dashed placeholder box where an image preview would be, shown when a media item has no image or the file fails to load.
No media items found: Empty-state message in the media picker dialog when the search or filter returns no media items (images) to choose from.
No results: Empty-state message inside an opened dropdown picker when the typed search matches none of the options.
No__boolean-flag: Default label of a yes/no flag cell in a list table, shown with a grey minus when the flag is off, e.g. Active column.
Nothing here yet: Empty-state message shown in a list or table that contains no entries at all, before any search or filter is applied.

Refreshing list: Accessible name (screen-reader label) of the thin loading bar shown over a list's toolbar while the list reloads in the background.
Remove %label%: Accessible label of the small X button on a chip in a multi-select, removing that choice. %label% is the chosen value, for example German.
Remove__media-field-action: Button label next to a media field; click to clear the chosen image reference from the form. Takes effect only after the form is saved.
Request contains invalid data: Title of the red error toast and error box above a form after the server rejected a save because one or more fields are invalid (the fields are listed below it).
Save changes: Sample text of the primary button specimen in the UI showcase; imperative, a typical save action. Maintenance UI showcase screen, Buttons section.
Search: Accessible label of a search input field in a list toolbar, read by screen readers. Use the plain noun or verb for searching.
Search…: Placeholder text inside a search box above a list or table, and the generic placeholder of a dropdown's search field. Ends with an ellipsis.
Sections: Accessible name (screen reader label) of the sub-tab bar below a section heading when the heading is not plain text.
Sections__tab-navigation: Default accessible name (screen reader label, not visible) of the tab bar under the header of a detail screen, whose tabs switch between sections of the record such as General, Teams or Rides. Plural noun.
Select %title%: Screen-reader label of a media tile button in the picker dialog; %title% is the media item's title, e.g. 'Summer campaign banner'.
Select all: Button at the bottom of a multi-select dropdown that selects every option in the list at once.
Select all loaded: Tooltip and accessible label of the checkbox in the table header that selects every row currently loaded in the list. Used for bulk actions.
Select row %rowKey%: Accessible label of a row checkbox in a selectable table, read by screen readers. %rowKey% is the row's technical ID, for example 1042.
Select__media-field-action: Button label under an empty media field; click to open the picker and choose an existing media item (image). Shown when nothing is chosen yet.
Select…: Placeholder of a multi-select dropdown while nothing is picked. Prompts the user to open the list and choose values. Ends with an ellipsis.
Show all (%count%): Small floating pill button at the bottom edge of a group panel; clicking it reveals all rows. %count% is the total number of rows, for example 12.
Show less: Small floating pill button at the bottom edge of an expanded group panel; clicking it shows only the first few rows again.
Sort by__media-picker: Small label above the sort dropdown in the media picker dialog; the dropdown picks the order of the media tiles, e.g. newest first.
Sort__media-picker: Fallback label of the sort dropdown button in the media picker dialog, shown when no sort option is currently selected.
Table view: Tooltip and accessible label of the icon button in a list toolbar that switches the list to a table with rows and columns.

Token authentication failed: Error message from the server when the login session token is invalid or expired; the user has to sign in again.
Translate to: Form label above the language chips in the AI translation panel of an admin form; the chips are the target languages.
Translate to selected locales: Button in the AI translation panel that starts translating the texts into all language chips the user selected. Imperative.
Translating…: Label of a button while the automatic AI translation is running for the selected languages; progress state, keep the ellipsis.
Translation failed: Fallback error message shown in the tooltip of a failed language in the translation progress list when the server gave no message.
Unauthorized: Short error message from the server when the request needs a valid login (session expired or missing); the user has to sign in again.
Unknown error: Fallback text for a single server-side validation message that arrived without any error text. Shown in the error list above a form after a failed save.
Unreadable file: Error message shown when a picked file could not be read by the browser during an image upload in the media picker.
Unsaved changes: Status text next to the Save and Cancel buttons of an edit form, shown while the user has changed fields that are not saved yet.
Updated__entity-metadata: Label in the metadata block of a detail screen, placed before the date and time the record was last modified, for example 'Updated 12 Nov 2026, 10:15'. Keep it short.
Upload__media-picker: Button in the media picker dialog header; click to choose image files from the computer and upload them as new media items.
Uploading…__media-picker: Button label in the media picker dialog while selected image files are being uploaded; the button is disabled meanwhile.
View: Label and accessible name of the toggle on the Home screen that switches between the Timeline and Kanban views.
Error message on the login page when the e-mail address / username or the password is wrong.
Yes: Option of a yes/no filter in the filter panel of a list; selecting it shows only records where the flag is set.
Yes__boolean-flag: Default label of a yes/no flag cell in a list table, shown with a green check when the flag is on, e.g. Active column.
You have unsaved changes. Closing now wi: Body text of the discard confirmation dialog, warning that closing the form drawer throws away the user's unsaved edits.
Row number: Screen-reader name of the narrow '#' column at the start of a list table that numbers the loaded rows 1, 2, 3 …
Clear: Accessible name and tooltip of the small × inside a picker (combobox) that removes the picked value, leaving the field empty.
Copied: Toast after a copy button put a value (an id, a link, a code) on the clipboard.
Could not copy: Error toast when the browser refused to put a value on the clipboard (no permission or an insecure page).
Create “%term%”: Last row of a picker's search list: creates a new entry named by the typed text (%term%) because no existing entry has that name.
Search for a command to run…: Hidden (screen-reader only) description of the command palette dialog, telling the user to search for a command or page to run.
Waiting__translation-status: Short form of the status 'Waiting for Customer', on a compact status button in the support ticket sidebar. Keep it to one short word.
Translating__translation-status: Status badge of one language in the translation progress list: the translation request is running right now.
Done__translation-status: Status badge of one language in the translation progress list: the translation finished successfully.
Failed__translation-status: Status badge label (short pill) in lists, cards and detail views, describing the state of a push notification or mail delivery attempt. Keep it short, like a status word. Also used for other status families.

All time: Preset of a date range filter (a segmented control above two date fields): no date limit.
Custom__date-range: Preset of a date range filter: the user picks the start and end dates in two date fields.
Last 7 days: Preset of a date range filter: today and the six days before it.

Actions__table-column: Screen-reader name (hidden header) of the last table column, which holds a row's buttons (edit, delete, restart), in lists and admin screens.
Only the loaded rows are selected; more: Note in the bulk action bar of a list when every loaded row is selected but the list has more rows that are not loaded yet.

Reset: Button of the image crop dialog: put the crop frame back to its start.
